newsitem.title: UK: Scot Radio says Q1 performance "well ahead".
newsitem.headline: Scot Radio says Q1 performance "well ahead".

text.p: Scottish Radio Holdings said on Thursday its group turnover for the first quarter was "well ahead" of the same period in the previous year and had so far reported a "robust" operating performance.

"The largest part of the rise in turnover arises from first-time contributions from West Sound Radio in South West Scotland and from Downtown Radio in Northern Ireland," the company's chairman James Gordon told the annual meeting.
Gordon said like-for-like advertising revenue from its local newspaper division rose seven percent.
He said Scottish Radio was expecting a six percent growth in broadcast revenue in January 1997.
"By December 31, the group had eliminated its modest level of net borrowings at 30 September, and is now ungeared," Gordon said.
"We remain confident in the outlook for the year as a whole, and in the longer term prospects for the group," he added.
